newsitem.title: POLAND: INDONESIA TEXMACO MAY INVEST IN POLISH NFI FORTUNA.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIA TEXMACO MAY INVEST IN POLISH NFI FORTUNA.

text.p: Indonesia's Texmaco Group plans to invest in textile firms grouped under National Investment Fund Fortuna SA (NFI XIII), its president said on Monday.
"We are planning that after investing (in Fortuna), the turnover of our joint undertaking will be some $200 to $300 million," Marimutu Sinivasan told a news conference.
He said Texmaco was eyeing investment in the Elana polyester firm located in the central Polish city of Torun and a deal should be hammered out within two weeks.
He did not disclose further details or the value of Texmaco's planned investment in Poland.
